query:
UPDATE
            sensor
        SET
            topic = $1,
            dry_adc = $2,
            wet_adc = $3,
            plant_id = $4,
            updated_at = NOW(),
            archived_at =
                CASE
                    WHEN $6
                    THEN COALESCE(archived_at, NOW())
                    ELSE NULL
                END
        WHERE
            id = $5
            AND (archived_at IS NULL OR NOT $6)
